newsitem.title: EGYPT: East Delta profit up in 95/96.
newsitem.headline: East Delta profit up in 95/96.

text.p: East Delta Flour Mills said on Thursday it made net after tax profits of 27.886 million pounds ($8.20 million) in the financial year 1995/96, slightly up on 27.660 million in the previous year.
The financial years end on June 30.
The firm's net sales also rose to 390.95 million pounds from 352.37 million in 94/95, a company statement published in newspapers showed.
The Egyptian state in September sold off 60.75 percent of East Delta, the second company in the strategic mills sector to leave state control.

The portion of profits allocated for shareholders increased to 23.698 million pounds in 1995/96, equivalent to 3.95 pounds for each of its six million shares, up from 19.342 million pounds the previous year.
Brokers had earlier said audited 1995/96 net profits were 27.78 million pounds compared with 27.62 million in 1994/95.
Pre-tax profits in the first quarter of 1996/97 rose to 9.7 million pounds from 6.2 million in the same period the previous year, a specialist magazine said this week.

The company said the value of projects under construction fell to 4.29 million pounds in 95/96 from 13.32 million in 94/95. It increased its paid-up capital to 60 million pounds from 48.123 million in the two years respectively.
East Delta shares closed on the Egyptian stock exchange on Thursday at 55.61 pounds.
